# Loan Appraisal and Default Risk Monitoring Notes

This document outlines critical actions for managing loan-related risks.

*   We need to monitor the default risk urgently.
*   We need to optimize the default risk based on audit.
*   We need to update the interest rates urgently.
*   We need to monitor the borrower credit score quarterly.
*   We need to review the collateral value quarterly.
